Package renderer

Class CameraIntersectionsIntegrationTests

java.lang.Object
renderer.CameraIntersectionsIntegrationTests
public class CameraIntersectionsIntegrationTests extends Object
Integration tests for verifying the number of intersection points between rays constructed by the Camera and different Geometry types.

Includes tests with Sphere, Plane, and Triangle.

  • Method Details

    • amountOfIntersections

      private void amountOfIntersections(Camera camera, Geometry geometry, int expectedAmount)
      Helper function to test the number of intersection points between rays constructed by the camera and a given geometry.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera from which rays are constructed
      geometry - the geometry to test intersections with
      expectedAmount - the expected number of intersection points

    • testSphereIntersection

      @Test void testSphereIntersection()
      Integration test for Sphere intersections with rays from the camera.
      • TC01: Sphere in front of camera, radius 1 — expects 2 intersections
      • TC02: Sphere around view plane — expects 18 intersections
      • TC03: Smaller sphere in front — expects 10 intersections
      • TC04: Sphere covers view plane — expects 9 intersections
      • TC05: Sphere behind camera — expects 0 intersections

    • testPlaneIntersection

      @Test void testPlaneIntersection()
      Integration test for Plane intersections with rays from the camera.
      • TC01: Plane perpendicular to view direction — expects 9 intersections
      • TC02: Plane with slight angle to view direction — expects 9 intersections
      • TC03: Plane angled such that only part of rays intersect — expects 6 intersections

    • testTriangleIntersection

      @Test void testTriangleIntersection()
      Integration test for Triangle intersections with rays from the camera.
      • TC01: Narrow triangle — expects 1 intersection
      • TC02: Wider triangle — expects 2 intersections
